name: New Jersey
agency: New Jersey State Police, Marine Services Bureau

rule.hpNote: any power vessel (including electric) or PWC
rule.textEn: Everyone who operates a power vessel or a PWC in New Jersey needs a Boating Safety Certificate from an approved course; on non-tidal lakes and rivers an MVC boat license is also needed.
rule.textEs: Toda persona que maneje una embarcación con motor o una moto acuática en Nueva Jersey necesita el certificado de seguridad náutica de un curso aprobado; en lagos y ríos sin marea también hace falta la licencia de bote de la MVC.

minAge.note: Ages 13-15 with a certificate may run only an electric-motor boat or a boat 12 ft or longer under 10 hp; PWC from 16 only, visitors included.

exemptions: Non-motorized vessels such as sailboats and canoes without motors.
Visitors (up to 90 days) with a home-state certificate, a USCG captain's license or proof of a NASBLA-approved course.

card.feeNote: No state fee stated for the certificate; replacements are requested from the Marine Services Bureau by email or mail. The separate MVC boat license for non-tidal waters costs $18.

nonResident: Visitors may use a home-state certificate, a USCG captain's license or proof of a NASBLA-approved course; after 90 days in NJ waters a New Jersey certificate is required. New residents need a NJ course.
pwcExtra: No PWC operation under 16. On non-tidal waters a separate MVC boat license (age 16+, $18) is also needed for power boats and PWCs.
